messages:
marta: Heads up — noticed console main-thread p95 jump after last telemetry change. Charts (sparklines) stutter, LCP up ~400ms. Repro on prod canary.

devon: ack. which change? telemetry client bump to 3.2.0?

marta: yes. 3.2.0 enabled batched ingestion + extra context serialization. Network shows huge POSTs to /telemetry/ingest ~500KB each for some routes.

sam: yikes. do we have a payload example? can you paste headers/log snippet?

marta: pasted below:

```
POST /telemetry/ingest 200 512384B 86ms
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: redwood-console/3.2.0
```

nina: that size explains parse/GC pressure. browser main thread parsing 500KB JSON repeatedly will kill render.

yusuf: possible quick mitigations: 1) revert telemetry client in canary 2) enable gzip on sidecar 3) sample lower or batch differently 4) lazy-load telemetry lib behind interaction

marta: can revert. canary at 10% right now. deploy-bot: canary deploy 2024-10-18T09:05 succeeded (id: canary-20241018-09)

devon: let's not rollback blind. try toggling telemetry sampling flag (feature flag) for canary first. if that helps, ship sampling change to full.

sam: also consider moving heavy shape/labeling transforms off main thread -> web worker. short-term we can zero out context expansion in client.

nina: agree. quick PR: 1) add server-side compression header acceptance + enable gzip in sidecar 2) patch client to skip verbose context for low-priority routes. I'll open PR now.

marta: opening followups: #1 reduce sample from 1.0 -> 0.05 for canary, #2 add server gzip, #3 add telemetry-lib lazy import on route mount. I'll coordinate.

yusuf: add a metric to show telemetry payload size distribution so we can alert if >100KB.

marta: good call. infra-bot: created alert telem.payload.size.p95 > 100KB in prod (rule 101). linking graph.

devon: timeline? can we ship sampling toggle + alert in next hour and observe?

marta: yes. sampling toggle deployed to canary at 2024-10-18T09:40. initial p95 main-thread delta down ~120ms. will monitor for 30m then decide rollback or full rollout.

sam: thanks. long-term: prefer thinner client payloads + server deref of heavy refs. add RFC in docs backlog.

nina: PR 8345 opened for gzip + client context opt-out. tagging @marta @devon for review.

marta: perfect. postmortem if we hit larger regression. :mechanical_arm:

deploy-bot: canary sampling toggle deployed (id: toggle-20241018-0940).
